title: Whole Mount X-gal Staining
protocol: Isolate the intestine and flush with cold PLP fixative.
Cut the intestines longitudinally and wash in PBS.
Cut the intestines into sixths and pin in a dish with villi facing up.
Incubate in cold PLP fix for 1 hour shaking at room temperature.
Wash in PBS and incubate in DTT solution for 45 minutes shaking at room temperature.
Wash in PBS and incubate in β-gal staining solution overnight shaking in the dark at 4°C.
Wash the pinned intestines in PBS.
Use the stained intestines for whole mount analysis or further processing for sectioning.
Score the number of positive villi under a Leica MZ6 dissecting microscope at 20X power.
Use a 25mm² field of view to score the positive villi.
Each field of view represents 1/28 of each strip of small intestine.
Each field of view represents 1200 villi in the entire small intestine, which extrapolates to 201,600 villi.
Count at least 20 β-gal+ foci for each third of the small intestine.
Consider nearby β-gal+ foci independent if not arising from the same crypt and surrounded by non-staining crypts.
Score adenomas involving multiple villi by whole mount and in cross sections.
Determine microadenomas involving a single villus by scoring cross sections.
